#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    int N = n + m;

    vector<long long> inv(N + 1);
    if (N >= 1) inv[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= N; ++i) {
        inv[i] = MOD - (MOD / i) * inv[MOD % i] % MOD;
    }

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; ++i) {
        p = p * (n - i) % MOD * inv[N - i] % MOD;
        phaseSize += p;
        if (phaseSize >= MOD) phaseSize -= MOD;
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    long long comb = 1;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
        comb = comb * (n - k + 1) % MOD * inv[k] % MOD;
        long long term = comb * (m + k) % MOD * inv[k] % MOD * phaseSize % MOD;
        if ((k & 1) == 0) term = (MOD - term) % MOD;
        answer += term;
        if (answer >= MOD) answer -= MOD;
    }

    cout << answer << '\n';
    return 0;
}
